notes: Check 1: no Clarity election list for Hays (elections.json 404). The county Elections page (hayscountytx.gov/172/Elections, CivicPlus) links only an 'Election Results Archive' (Archive.aspx?AMID=53), whose entries (for example 'May 26, 2026 Primary Runoff', 'March 3, 2026 Primaries', 'November 5, 2024 General (ZIP)') hold only official files: 'Official Canvass Results', 'Official Cumulative Results', 'Official Results Reports (ZIP)', CVR export, certification and reconciliation. This server stamps every page with the request time as Last-Modified, so it gives no upload evidence. One web search listed an egovlink.com-hosted 'Cumulative Results - Democratic Party - unofficial' PDF for the 2026 primary, but that URL now returns 404, and a livevoterturnout.com/HaysTX election-night site that only covers November 2020 (Last-Modified 2022). No election-night file for the three target elections could be read. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin). Targeted pass 2026-10-02 (targeted-Hays): no election changed. Tried: (1) livevoterturnout.com/HaysTX/LiveResults/en/Index_5.html source: static page, data embedded inline (precinctData = per-precinct check-ins/turnout, not candidate votes), electionIdVar 5, updated 11/4/2020; directory URLs return 403; no data files for 2024-2026 elections, so this vendor site is not where Hays posted the target elections. (2) Wayback harvest branch: one election-night capture, hayscountytx.gov/elections/20260303 at 2026-03-03 20:35 CST (the county used a Duda site at /elections/YYYYMMDD then; it now 404s after a move to CivicPlus): 'All EV locations reporting / ED locations reporting: 0 / 35' with only 'Cumulative Reporting' links to egovlink unofficial cumulative PDFs (now 404). This shows county totals posted on election night, but the capture predates any election-day results, so it cannot show whether precinct numbers came later that night; 2026_primary stays UNDETERMINED (lead toward LATER). No 2024 general capture (CDX connection refused; in 2024 the county site was hayscountytx.com, which the harvest did not target and which the fetch module reports unreachable) and no runoff capture. (3) phase1/targeted/archives/Hays and phase1/targeted/wayback/Hays: not on the wayback-data branch at start or at finish (checked three times). Wayback CDX from here is refused by the fetch module. (4) Check 4: Hays Free Press 2026 primary (updated 23:14 election night) and University Star 2024 live updates give county totals only; KUT runoff page gives county totals only; Fox7 2024 page had no precinct numbers; Wimberley View, Dripping Springs News and Hays Free Press 2024 pages return 404. No third-party per-precinct numbers found. Leads: web search listed egovlink 'Cumulative Results - 20260526 Dem unofficial.pdf' (runoff) and, for the Nov 2025 election (not a target), 'Canvass Results Unofficial.pdf', which suggests Hays sometimes posts unofficial precinct canvass reports; all such egovlink files now 404. Later Wayback captures of hayscountytx.gov/elections/20260303 and /20260526, hayscountytx.com election pages (Nov 2024), and egovlink.com/public_documents300/hayscounty/published_documents/departments/elections/results/ would decide these elections. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-C): no election changed. Tried: (1) Wayback availability API and replay for the egovlink unofficial cumulative PDF linked from the 2026-03-03 20:35 CST capture: archive.org returned HTTP 429 and web.archive.org is refused by the fetch module (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). (2) egovlink.com directly: the unofficial primary file ('.../results/2026/0303 Primaries/Cumulative Results - Republican Party - unoffcial.pdf') still returns 404 and the folder listings '.../0303 Primaries/' and '.../0526 Primary Runoff/' return 403; only the official runoff cumulative ('.../0526 Primary Runoff/Official Cumulative Results - Republican Party 20260526 Primary Runoff.pdf', hash 362f6c7f...) loads, which is post-canvass. (3) The CivicPlus archive ZIPs are titled 'Official Results Reports' (post-canvass) and were not opened. (4) Check 4: two web searches; Hays Free Press 2024 coverage and Dripping Springs News 2024 results pages still return 404; search snippets give county totals 'as of 11:13 p.m.' only (not evidence). (5) phase1/targeted/archives/Hays and phase1/targeted/wayback/Hays are on the branch but hold no mementos or captures (archive.today timemaps empty; Memento aggregator unreachable). Sweep pending (no phase1/targeted/sweep/Hays on the branch at finish).
